page.overview:
Who is Orderly?

After Michael Myers was burned during his battle with Sara Moyer and Freddie Harris on October 31, 2002, he was brought to the local morgue, where the orderly and a co-worker delivered him to the coroner to undergo routine procedures. The orderly grinned as he told the coroner that her nightly charge was the famed serial killer Michael Myers. On his way out the door, he chided her for making a sarcastic remark regarding Michael's "celebrity" status. The orderly then went off to finish his late-night shift, leaving his colleague alone to work on the notorious mass murderer, who was actually still alive.
